business_problem: Government departments needed to process and analyse consultation responses from industry and the public, including large volumes of text, and produce summaries that could help identify themes and prepare replies.
solution_summary: Government Actuary's Department used ChatGPT to help government clients process consultation responses and create an initial view of respondents' positions. For a central-government consultation, source responses came from people in industry and the public; the team grouped respondents by industry so themes could be considered within those groups. The team fed ChatGPT the largest responses (about 50) for each question and instructed it to summarise views in 1 to 2 paragraphs. An actuary read the generated summaries to check technical correctness, and the team further edited them. The outputs were collated into 40 summarised responses, one per question, from which staff drew themes and collated replies. The source reports close to half a million words processed through AI or human reading, but does not identify a storage system, data interface, or separate serving component.

solution_components.name: ChatGPT
solution_components.role: Summarised the largest consultation responses by question into 1 to 2 paragraphs for review by an actuary.

business_outcome: ChatGPT summaries provided a useful starting point for analysing and coherently presenting consultation responses; staff reviewed and edited the output and used the collated summaries to draw themes and prepare replies.

source_references.title: Half a million words analysed by AI

evidence_quotes: We used the AI program ChatGPT to summarise the largest consultation responses (about 50 out of the number received).
The team fed in all these responses for each question and instructed the AI program to summarise views in 1 to 2 paragraphs.
The output was read by an actuary to ensure it reflected a technically correct summary.
The output was then collated into 40 summarised responses (one per question) from which we were able to draw out key themes and collate replies.
In all we processed close to half a million words through either the use of AI or reading responses.
